studio.title: Composer reference
studio.summary: Deterministic reference fixture for sf-chat-composer: files allowed (.pdf, .docx, up to five, 10 MB each), the field empty.

pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-chat-composer against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.9 §12, gate 20); the behaviour simai/ui-chat's tests/browser/staff.test.mjs holds for it: Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, the stop button while an answer is awaited, the count past 80 %, the files checked and their chips
pages.format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

checks.title: Enter sends the trimmed text as sf-chat-composer-submit {text, attachment-ids} once, and the 0.3 sf-chat-send {text, attachmentIds} once, noted with its dates; the composer does not clear itself
checks.covers: events.submit, aliases sf-chat-send, keyboard Enter commit, values.value

steps.script: (await customElements.whenDefined('sf-chat-composer'), document.querySelector('#plain').value = '  Сколько дней отпуска?  ', document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__input').focus(), true)
steps.check: document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__send').disabled === false && document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__send').classList.contains('sf-icon-button--primary')
document.querySelector('#plain').value === '  Сколько дней отпуска?  '

checks.title: Shift+Enter breaks the line and sends nothing; an empty field sends nothing on Enter and its send button is quiet (tonal on-surface), not a disabled primary

steps.check: document.querySelector('#plain').value.includes('\n')

(() => { const b = document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__send'); return b.disabled && b.classList.contains('sf-icon-button--tonal') && b.classList.contains('sf-icon-button--on-surface') && b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Отправить'; })()

checks.title: busy: send becomes «Остановить ожидание»; Enter with text sends nothing and the hint says why; the stop button sends sf-chat-composer-stop and the 0.3 sf-chat-stop once and gives the focus back to the field; not busy, the hint is the Enter hint again
checks.covers: settings.busy, events.stop, aliases sf-chat-stop, runtime.busy-text, runtime.hint-text

steps.script: (await customElements.whenDefined('sf-chat-composer'), document.querySelector('#plain').busy = true, document.querySelector('#plain').value = 'Ещё вопрос', document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__input').focus(), true)
steps.check: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#plain'); return c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__send').hidden && !c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__stop').hidden && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__stop').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Остановить ожидание' && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__hint').textContent.trim() === 'Enter — отправить, Shift+Enter — новая строка'; })()

(() => { const h = document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__hint'); return h.textContent.trim() === 'Дождитесь ответа или остановите ожидание' && h.classList.contains('sf-chat-composer__hint--busy') && h.getAttribute('aria-live') === 'polite'; })()
document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__input')

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('#plain'); return !c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__send').hidden && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__stop').hidden && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__hint').textContent.trim() === 'Enter — отправить, Shift+Enter — новая строка' && !c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__hint--busy'); })()

checks.title: past 80 % of maxlength the count shows and describes the field; past the limit it says so, the box is in error and send is off

steps.check: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#limit'); const count = c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__count'); return count.hidden && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__input').getAttribute('aria-describedby') === count.id; })()

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('#limit'); const count = c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__count'); return !count.hidden && count.textContent.trim() === '10 из 10' && !c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer--over') && !c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__send').disabled; })()

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('#limit'); return c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__count').textContent.trim() === 'Сообщение длиннее 10 знаков' && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer--over') !== null && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__send').disabled && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__said').textContent.trim() === 'Сообщение длиннее 10 знаков'; })()

checks.title: files from the picker are checked by type, size and count: the refused are named in the alert notice, the accepted go in sf-chat-composer-attach and the 0.3 sf-chat-files once
checks.covers: settings.accept, settings.max-bytes, settings.max-files, events.attach, aliases sf-chat-files, runtime.bad-type-text, runtime.too-big-text, runtime.too-many-text

steps.script: (await customElements.whenDefined('sf-chat-composer'), window.__attached = null, document.querySelector('#files').addEventListener('sf-chat-composer-attach', (event) => { window.__attached = event.detail.files.map((file) => file.name); }, {once: true}), true)

(() => { const dt = new DataTransfer(); for (const [name, size] of [['a.pdf', 10], ['setup.exe', 10], ['big.pdf', 2048], ['b.docx', 10], ['c.pdf', 10]]) dt.items.add(new File(['x'.repeat(size)], name)); const picker = document.querySelector('#files').querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__picker'); picker.files = dt.files; picker.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const notice = document.querySelector('#files').querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__notice'); return JSON.stringify(window.__attached) === JSON.stringify(['a.pdf', 'b.docx']) && !notice.hidden && notice.getAttribute('role') === 'alert' && notice.textContent === 'setup.exe: этот тип файла не поддерживается; big.pdf: файл больше 1 КБ; c.pdf: можно прикрепить не больше 2 файлов'; })()

checks.title: set-files, the 0.3 setFiles: chips with size, upload progress and the server's refusal; while one uploads send is off and the files button is off at max-files; a chip's remove sends sf-chat-composer-detach {id, name} and the 0.3 sf-chat-action {action: remove-attachment, id, name}
checks.covers: settings.files, actions.set-files, events.detach, aliases sf-chat-action, runtime.file-label, runtime.uploading-text, runtime.remove-label

steps.check: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#files'); const chips = c.querySelectorAll('.sf-chat-composer__files .sf-chat-attachment'); const bar = c.querySelector('.sf-chat-attachment--uploading [role=progressbar]'); return chips.length === 3 && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-attachment--ready').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Файл Договор.pdf, 47 КБ' && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-attachment--ready .sf-chat-attachment__meta').textContent.trim() === '47 КБ' && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-attachment--uploading .sf-chat-attachment__meta').textContent.trim() === 'Загружается, 40%' && bar?.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '40' && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-attachment--error .sf-chat-attachment__meta').getAttribute('role') === 'alert' && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__send').disabled && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__attach').disabled && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__box--tall') !== null; })()

checks.title: a ready file with no text can be sent: submit carries its id

steps.check: document.querySelector('#files').querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__send').disabled === false

checks.title: clear empties the field; focus() lands in the field; disabled turns the field and send off

steps.check: document.querySelector('#plain').value === '' && document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__input').value === ''
document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__input')

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('#plain'); return c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__input').disabled && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__send').disabled && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer--disabled') !== null; })()

checks.title: queue: while busy a message of text still goes out as sf-chat-composer-submit, by Enter or by «Отправить после ответа» beside «Остановить ожидание», and the hint says it goes after the answer; a message with files waits and the hint says why
checks.covers: settings.queue, settings.busy, events.submit, runtime.queue-label, runtime.queue-hint-text, runtime.busy-files-text

steps.script: (await customElements.whenDefined('sf-chat-composer'), document.querySelector('#plain').busy = true, document.querySelector('#plain').queue = true, document.querySelector('#plain').value = 'Ещё вопрос', document.querySelector('#plain .sf-chat-composer__input').focus(), true)
steps.check: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#plain'); const send = c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__send'); return !send.hidden && !send.disabled && send.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Отправить после ответа' && !c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__stop').hidden && c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__hint').textContent.trim() === 'Enter — отправить после ответа, Shift+Enter — новая строка'; })()
document.querySelector('#plain').value === 'Ещё вопрос'
(() => { const c = document.querySelector('#plain'); return c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__send').hidden && !c.querySelector('.sf-chat-composer__stop').hidden; })()

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#files').busy = true, document.querySelector('#files').queue = true, document.querySelector('#files').files = [{id: 'att_1', name: 'Договор.pdf', bytes: 512}], document.querySelector('#files').value = 'С файлом', document.querySelector('#files .sf-chat-composer__input').focus(), true)
steps.check: document.querySelector('#files .sf-chat-composer__send').hidden
document.querySelector('#files .sf-chat-composer__hint').textContent.trim() === 'Сообщение с файлами можно отправить, когда придёт ответ'
